note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 3 homes for sale in Brazil, each one checked by a person.
In Brazil, the median asking price of those 3 homes is €100,733 (€392 per m², from the 3 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €62,683 and the most expensive €120,858.
With 3 homes this is a small sample, so the median for Brazil is a rough guide.

homes.title: Country house with panoramic views and pool in Itatiba, São Paulo State
homes.title_es: Casa de campo con vistas panorámicas y piscina en Itatiba, estado de São Paulo
homes.summary: Single-storey country house in Itatiba, São Paulo State. It has 2 bedrooms, a living room with a mezzanine, a kitchen, 2 bathrooms, a laundry room, a gourmet area with a barbecue and wood-burning stove, and a storage room. Outdoors there is a swimming pool with deck, a veranda, a vegetable garden, an orchard, a garage for 6 cars with 1 covered, an automatic gate, an annex, and 12,917 sq ft of land with panoramic views. The neighbourhood has paved roads, a variety of shops and a health centre. Asking €100,733, about €347/m².

homes.title: Rural 2-bedroom house with pool and garden in Atibaia, São Paulo
homes.title_es: Casa rural de 2 dormitorios con piscina y jardín en Atibaia, São Paulo
homes.summary: This single-storey rural house offers 280 m² of built area on a 981 m² plot. It has 2 bedrooms, a family bathroom, an additional bathroom and a welcoming living room. Outdoor features include a swimming pool, a garden, an orchard, a walled plot, a rear balcony with sunset views and a barbecue area. It has mains electricity and a traditional well. It is about 40 minutes from São Paulo, with easy access to the Fernão Dias Highway. Asking €120,858, about €432/m².

homes.title: 4-bedroom house with garage and front balcony in Cabo Frio, Rio de Janeiro
homes.title_es: Casa de 4 dormitorios con garaje y balcón delantero en Cabo Frio, Río de Janeiro
homes.summary: This house in Cabo Frio, Rio de Janeiro offers 160 m2 of living space on 1,722 sq ft of land. It has 4 bedrooms, including 1 en-suite, and 2 bathrooms. The layout includes 2 living rooms, a dining area, a kitchen and a utility room. The home is on the upper level, with access via the garage, which has 1 parking space, and it has a front balcony. Asking €62,683, about €392/m².
